The weapon features a metallic receiver with a top-mounted carrying handle/sight assembly, a pistol grip, and a long, curved magazine inserted into the grip. A coiled wire stock is visible extending from the rear. The finish appears to be a mix of matte metal and dark polymer. There is a distinct shadow cast across the lower portion of the image.
